• Two of the UK’s finest Hindustani musicians perform the rare Raag Ahiri - a scale which rotates Raag Charukeshi (known as murchana/modality).
Learn more about the music:
Harmeet Virdee is a leading British-based sitar exponent. He has performed on the BBC and at a range of leading festivals, and is also committed to teaching students and newcomers, leading Darbar’s Indian music appreciation courses. He has learnt his art from a young age from Dharambir Singh and then informal learning with Pandit Budhaditya Mukherjee, Ustad Shahid Parvez, Pandit Arvind Parikh and others.
